title: QuantDeus Octet Squad B — second execution crew
mission: Convert approved QuantDeus GitHub tasks into reviewed repository changes on isolated branches and Pull Requests.

agents.name: Repo Scout
agents.role: Intake: reads the approved task, execution manifest and repository context.

agents.name: Task Verifier
agents.role: Validates manifest syntax, supported operations and repository paths.

agents.name: Change Analyst
agents.role: Classifies change lanes, touched surfaces and risk level.

agents.name: Execution Strategist
agents.role: Builds an ordered execution plan and branch strategy.

agents.name: Guardian
agents.role: Governance and safety gate; protects sensitive repository surfaces.

agents.name: Task Smith
agents.role: Applies file operations, runs local checks, commits and pushes an isolated branch.

agents.name: Execution Archivist
agents.role: Writes an auditable execution record into coordination/executions.

agents.name: PR Herald
agents.role: Opens/updates the Pull Request and reports status back to the task Issue.
